The filing date December 20, 1939 and the issue date December 22, 1939 are the alternatives if effectiveness is dated from filing or publication. The Federal Register docket line reads 'Filed, December 20, 1939;' and the issue is headed 'Washington, Friday, December 22, 1939'.

It does not revoke or name this order and is rejected as a lead. Later instruments: the packet's later-events search of Office of the Federal Register disposition notes (1937 onward) and its current-law searches of the U.S. Code and the eCFR were selected after reading their coverage notes, and each returned no hit for this order. Bailey from compulsory retirement for age under section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932, for a term it states as 'for a period of one year ending March 31, 1941'. Whereas, in my judgment, the public interest requires that Fred C. Bailey, Fleet Manager, Maintenance and Repair Division, United States Maritime Commission, who was exempted from compulsory retirement for age for a period of one year ending March 31, 1940, by Executive Order No. 8060 of March 7, 1939, be further exempted from such compulsory retirement for a period of one year:

Now, Therefore, by virtue of and pursuant to the authority vested in me by section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932, 47 Stat. 382, 404 (U.S.C., title 5, sec. 715a), I hereby further exempt the said Fred C. Bailey from compulsory retirement for age for a period of one year ending March 31, 1941.

FRANKLIN D ROOSEVELT

Whereas, in my judgment, the public interest requires that Zeke Johnson, custodian, Natural Bridges National Monument, National Park Service, Department of the Interior, who was exempted from compulsory retirement for age for a period of one year ending April 30, 1940, by Executive Order No. 8094 of April 19, 1939, be further exempted from such compulsory retirement for a period of one year:

Now, Therefore, by virtue of and pursuant to the authority vested in me by section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932, 47 Stat. 382, 404 (U.S.C., title 5, sec. 715a), I hereby further exempt the said Zeke Johnson from compulsory retirement for age for a period of one year ending April 30, 1941.

FRANKLIN D ROOSEVELT

The White House,

April 12, 1940.
